mechanism: Benztropine's anticholinergic effects may reduce gastrointestinal motility and fluid absorption, potentially affecting candesartan bioavailability and efficacy, while candesartan may potentiate benztropine-induced orthostatic hypotension.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; educate patient on orthostatic precautions and adequate hydration; consider alternative antiparkinson agent if hypotension develops.
